name: title-to-zone1
title: Omega Boost (USA)
notes: Skips the intro, opens the main menu, starts Campaign Play, leaves the briefing and idles in zone 1. buttons is the inverted pad word: 65535 neutral, 65527 Start. Each shot step ends 30 neutral frames before the next press, because shots land a few frames after their step ends.

steps.note: boot and intro; every boot mode is in the intro movie by the end
title screen; Start presses 300 and 600 frames after the skip did nothing in exploration
